# Contributing to Chic Builder 🚀

Welcome to the **Chic Builder** open-source development ecosystem! We build high-performance visual design tools, serverless MongoDB utilities, and automated community services.

## How to Contribute

1. **Reporting Bugs**: Check the existing issues first. If not found, use our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/ChicBuilder/.github/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
2. **Proposing Features**: Share component ideas and proposals using the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/ChicBuilder/.github/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
3. **Submitting Pull Requests**:
   - Fork the repository and create a feature branch off `main`.
   - Ensure clean, descriptive commit messages.
   - Open a pull request using the provided template.
   - Our automated CI will run integrity tests on your changes.

## Community & Discussions

Join our active [Discord Community](https://discord.gg/7vaHhewmtJ) or visit our [Web Studio](https://chic-builder.vercel.app/) for live demos and updates.
